title: Digital Marketing Analyst
description: A roadmap for data-driven digital marketing: channels, campaign tracking, GA4, ads analytics, dashboards, experimentation, and ROI reporting.

tree.name: Marketing and Channel Foundations
tree.description: Understand funnels, personas, positioning, paid/organic channels, lifecycle marketing, attribution, and campaign goals.

children.name: Marketing Channels
children.description: Compare SEO, paid search, social, email, content, influencer, affiliate, and retargeting by intent and cost.

children.name: Funnel Metrics
children.description: Measure reach, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, leads, conversion rate, CAC, ROAS, retention, and LTV.

tree.name: Tracking and Analytics
tree.description: Set up measurement plans, UTMs, GA4 events, conversion goals, dashboards, and data quality checks.

children.name: GA4 and Tag Manager
children.description: Track events, conversions, audiences, UTM campaigns, ecommerce actions, consent, and debugging.

children.name: Dashboards and Reporting
children.description: Build dashboards in Looker Studio or spreadsheets that explain channel performance and next actions.

children.name: Practice: Campaign Readout Memo
children.description: Analyze campaign data, explain what changed, quantify ROI, and recommend budget or creative changes.

tree.name: Campaign Analysis and Experimentation
tree.description: Analyze paid and organic campaigns, design experiments, estimate incrementality, and communicate ROI.

children.name: Paid Search and Social Analysis
children.description: Analyze targeting, creatives, keywords, match types, bids, budgets, landing pages, and audience overlap.

children.name: A/B Testing and Attribution
children.description: Plan experiments, avoid false conclusions, compare attribution models, and report confidence and limitations.

tree.name: Portfolio and Business Communication
tree.description: Turn marketing data into decisions with clear insights, visual storytelling, and action-focused recommendations.

children.name: Insight Writing
children.description: Write concise summaries that state what changed, why it matters, what to do next, and what risk remains.

children.name: Project: Campaign Performance Dashboard
children.description: Build a dashboard using sample campaign data with UTMs, channel KPIs, budget pacing, conversion funnel, and recommendations.
